member.summary: GemBox: Run is an Inline element used to insert textual content to a document.

member.param: Destination file path. Process requires write priviledges.
List of tokens to be anonymized.

Custom function to replace anonymized expressions in the output document. Optional parameter, by default anonymized characters are replaced by the '*' character. Implemented for these file types: Csv, Txt, Htm, Html, Xhtml, Xml, Sql, Json.
member.exception: Pdf, Eml, Fo and Zfo file formats are not implemented.
